source_summary: Official MiniMax docs describe M3 adaptive thinking as native default, tools as supported, and generation length as capped including thinking. Interleaved multi-turn transcripts are distinct from our independent provider-neutral state-projection calls.
before: All forced function-output requests disabled M3 thinking.
after: Use native adaptive thinking with the same forced structured output, model, Profile, max_completion_tokens and timeout. Do not persist or display hidden reasoning; usage counts the full reported completion.

adapter_versions.paired: versioned existing paired format plus minimax-adaptive-v2

transport_retry_policy: Do not replay completion POSTs after ambiguous response or overload; retain bounded retries for idempotent GET catalog reads.
